Home.headline: A stock market for skills.
Home.lede: Built from Australian job ads, updated every week.
Home.heatLabel: Industries by job ads (tile size) and 4-week change (tile colour)
Home.moversRule: Chosen by one rule: the biggest 4-week changes, up or down, among skills, roles and industries with at least {min} job ads in the earlier 4 weeks. Nothing is hand-picked.
Home.moverLine: Ads {type, select, skill {mentioning {name}} role {for {name}} other {in {name}}} {dir, select, up {rose} down {fell} other {held at}} {from} → {to} in 4 weeks.
Home.moversEmpty: No instrument has enough ads to show a move right now.
Home.signalsNote: Signals describe the market. They don’t tell you what to learn — your interests and time matter more.
Home.howTitle: From a number to a conversation
Home.step1Body: Track skills and roles with your own filter — say, entry-level on-site in Sydney plus remote anywhere in Australia.
Home.step2Body: Each figure carries its definition, denominator, source and date one click away. Small samples are flagged, not charted.
Home.step3Body: When a signal is worth digging into, we match you with up to three verified practitioners and suggest what to ask.
Home.sampleNote: Numbers on this preview are illustrative.
